apps.localizedDescription:
Mi TV Remote:

Remote control apps for Xiaomi Mi TV (Android TV / PatchWall) on macOS, Android and iOS. They control the TV over Wi-Fi with no ADB, using a remote service built into the TV: Xiaomi's MiLink, with no pairing needed, or, on models without it, Google's Android TV remote service after a one-time pairing code.

MiLink's protocol isn't documented, so it was reverse engineered with REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) from the TV's own firmware (see How it was reverse engineered).

The macOS app opened from the menu bar (left) and the TV screen, recorded at the same time over ADB (right). Watch the MP4.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Xiaomi. "Mi" and "Xiaomi" are trademarks of their respective owners.

versions.localizedDescription:
First launch:

• macOS: the app is not notarized. Open it once, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
• macOS, after updating: if the app asks to use its key in your keychain, click Always Allow. That key is what the TV paired with.
• All platforms: allow Local Network access when asked; the app needs it to find and reach the TV.
• Mi TVs without MiLink (newer Android TV / Google TV models): the apps connect through the Android TV remote service instead. The first time, the TV shows a 6-character code; type it into the app.
• iPhone: apps sideloaded with a free Apple ID expire after 7 days; refresh them in AltStore/SideStore, or reinstall.

See the README for step-by-step instructions.
